name: Fink fast transient rate (fink-science ztf/fast_transient_rate)
quantity_returned: Per alert: mag_rate (mag/day) between the current detection and the most recent previous measurement in the same band (a detection, or an upper limit when the previous record in that band is a non-detection), with sigma, 5th and 95th percentiles from N Monte-Carlo samples, delta_time, from_upper; plus jd_first_real_det and jdstarthist_dt.
defining_paper: none located; card from code only
accuracy_against_scored_measurement: Not a scored quantity. Alive (finite mag_rate) fraction on this cohort: 0.9449 at E1, 0.9627 at E3.
what_it_is_not: Not a classifier. Not a light-curve fit. jdstarthist_dt was not computed here because ALeRCE light curves carry no jdstarthist field.
conventions: upper-limit case samples current flux against Uniform(0, flux(limit))
samples are shifted by +|min| of the whole sample matrix before log (processor.py 'Fix distribution')
a previous record in a band other than g/r stops the search and returns NaN (the 'TODO: change the logic for LSST' branch)
N=100, seed 0 in this calibration run

substitution.what: logic copied into scripts/features.py and run one unit per batch without pyspark

disagreements.code: the positivity shift uses np.min over current_mag_sample[:, idx_valid_data] for the whole DataFrame, so one alert's rate depends on which other alerts share the Spark partition
disagreements.this_run: one unit per batch, so the shift is per unit; Fink production values would differ

disagreements.docstring: jd_first_real_det is 'first variation time at 5 sigma contains in the alert history'
disagreements.code: get_last_alert takes cjd at the first non-NaN cmagpsf in the history arrays; no significance test is applied inside the function

current_mag_sample += np.abs(np.min(...)) is applied unconditionally (also when every sample is positive), adding a constant to both fluxes of the ratio, so mag_rate is not the rate between the measured fluxes

completeness: Covered from code: processor.py and utils.py in full. Not covered: notebook/, the Spark wrapper beyond the call signature, any paper.
